Title: Kingdom Blessings in the Beatitudes
Promise: In the kingdom of heaven, the poor in spirit, those who mourn, the meek, those hungering for righteousness, the merciful, the pure in heart, the peacemakers, and those persecuted for righteousness receive comfort, mercy, the earth as inheritance, satisfaction, sonship, sight of God, and great reward.
KeyScriptures: Matthew 5:3; Matthew 5:4; Matthew 5:5; Matthew 5:6; Matthew 5:7; Matthew 5:8; Matthew 5:9; Matthew 5:10; Matthew 5:11; Matthew 5:12
